registryEntry.idSafety: Colon-containing logical IDs are supported without placing the ID in a Windows filename.
registryEntry.strictness: Unknown fields, invalid schema/map/version/ID, duplicate IDs, unsafe paths, malformed SHA and bytes outside1–512KiB reject before fetching.

loader.deadline: Existing MapLoadLifetime provides one logical45s bound over fetch, bounded stream read, SHA and validation. External signal aborts fetch/reader. Late fetch responses have their body cancelled.
loader.size: Declared registry size is bounded to512KiB. The reader stops when bytes exceed the exact registered size or512KiB; no unbounded arrayBuffer fallback is used.
loader.integrity: Web Crypto SHA256 of exact fetched UTF8 bytes must match the content-addressed URL/index. ID/map/version/catalogRevision/duration must exactly match the validated document.
loader.references: Default loader derives the selected map's immutable base instance IDs when omitted. Game callers supply actual current base+overlay IDs; unknown/stale actor/asset/clip/audio/instance references reject via the same cinematic validator.
loader.ownership: No scene, engine, model, sound or permanent observer is created. This layer only returns verified data to the existing CinematicPlayer/SceneHost.

cli.default: Dryrun performs validation/planning only and writes nothing. --project DIR selects an explicit local project root; default is the repository project.
cli.bodyPreservation: The exported JSON text retains spacing, ordering and values. CRLF/CR line endings normalize to LF; no schema conversion or scene rewrite occurs. The resulting bytes determine the SHA-addressed file.
cli.instanceReferences: createBasePlacementManifest(doc.mapId) supplies base IDs. If the target project has a registered authored overlay, its bounded bytes/SHA/revision/baseRevision and strict placement schema are verified before adding its IDs.
cli.atomicity: An exclusive registry lock and unique same-directory staging files guard registration. Content is committed first and the index replaces atomically last. Current index text is rechecked before commit. Failure preserves the previous index; newly created unreferenced content is removed only when its exact expected hash still matches.
cli.scope: All write/staging/lock paths are resolved under the named real project root. Existing symlink/junction ancestors outside that root reject. No arbitrary cutscene ID is interpolated into a path.
cli.errors: Malformed input/stale references/hash conflicts/index changes/commit failures report errors without publishing a new entry. All owned stages and locks are cleaned; cleanup warnings remain explicit.
